from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class CaseDocument(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document regarding its classification."""
    title: str = Field(description="The actual title of the judgment document as provided (e.g. 《判决文书 1》)")
    case_type: Literal['赔偿案件', '民事案件', '执行案件'] = Field(description="The legal case type classification determined from the document")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    case_documents: list[CaseDocument]
